monument_name: Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā (second half of 19th cent. CE)
description_en: Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā is located to the west of Sunaguthi main road, to the south of the Dampāchẽ Phalcā (SUN4011). The Phalcā was recently expanded and modified in 2018-2019, and some of the historical materials were reused in the process. Before its reconstruction, the building was of a regular rectangular shape and was furnished with a conventional gable roof with pan-tiles. In the reconstruction process, the rear wall of the Phalcā was also removed. Its carved wooden pillars and lintels bear witness to its historicity; relying on these, the Phalcā can be dated to the second half of the 19th century.Nāmasaṅgīti Khalaḥ organises four months ofNāmasaṅgītirecitations in the Phalcā (from the full moon day of Śrāvaṇa to the full moon day of Kārttika). On the day of Indrajātrā and on the full moon day of Kārttika, apūjāis performed in the nearby Śikharakūṭa Caitya, which is located to the north of the Phalcā. At the end of thepūjātheguṭhī-members of the Caitya distributesamaybajiinside the Phalcā. According to local elders, there were three statues in the Phalcā. Two were of Mahākāla and Gaṇeśa whilst the final one was unidentified; all of them were stolen in the 1990s.
description_ne: यो फल्चा सुनागुथि मूल सडकको पश्चिमपट्टि दम्पाछेँ फल्चाको दक्षिणमा रहेको छ । सन् २०१९-१९ मा यस फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।फल्चासँग सम्बन्धित नामसङ्गीति खलः (समूह) ले चर्तुमासको अवधिमा (श्रावण शुक्ल पूर्णिमादेखि कार्तिक शुक्ल पूर्णिमासम्म) फल्चामा बसी नामसङ्गीति पाठ गर्ने गर्दछ । इन्द्रजात्रा र कार्तिक शुक्ल पूर्णिमा (कतिपुन्ही)का दिन फल्चाबाट उत्तरपूर्वमा पर्ने शिखरकूट चैत्यमा विशेष पूजा गर्ने परम्परा छ । पूजापश्चात् चैत्यका गुठीयारहरू यस फल्चामा उपस्थित भई समय्बजि वितरण गर्ने परम्परा छ । स्थानीय वृद्धहरूले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार पहिला फल्चामा महाकाल, गणेश र अर्को एउटा नचिनिएको मूर्ति पनि थियो जुन करिब दुई दशक अघि चोरी भयो।
